query:
UPDATE webhook_deliveries SET
             attempts = attempts + 1,
             delivered_at = CASE WHEN $2 THEN now() END,
             next_attempt_at = COALESCE($3, next_attempt_at),
             failed_at = CASE WHEN $4 THEN now() END,
             last_status = $5,
             last_error = $6
         WHERE unid = $1 RETURNING 1
